metadata.title: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² Monotherapy – 28 day
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00284 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC in older patients or patients with ECOG 2.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and use its toxicity-specific CTCAE definition; assess symptoms, intervention and functional impact before selecting the grade.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinically relevant domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered value requires protocol-specific Consultant/pharmacy review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold treatment and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.omit: Omit the relevant scheduled dose and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.
